title: From Visual Feedback to Textual Reviews: A Multi-Agent Vision-Language Framework for Image-Grounded Review Assistance
abstract: arXiv:2609.14761v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visual feedback in the form of user-uploaded images and videos is becoming increasingly common in e-commerce platforms because it provides authentic evidence of product quality, defects, packaging conditions, and real-world usage. However, visual feedback alone often lacks the contextual explanations and subjective opinions necessary for informed decision-making, while many users provide limited textual feedback due to the effort required to compose detailed reviews. To bridge this gap, we introduce image-grounded review assistance, a novel task that aims to generate editable review drafts from user-uploaded product images. Unlike conventional image captioning, which focuses on objective visual description, the proposed task requires product-specific understanding, sentiment estimation, and evidence-driven review composition under challenging real-world conditions, including degraded image quality, excessive zoom-in, target ambiguity,

translated_title: 从视觉反馈到文本评论：一种面向基于图像的评论辅助的多智能体视觉-语言框架
translated_abstract: 用户上传图片和视频形式的视觉反馈在电商平台中日益普遍，因为它提供了关于产品质量、缺陷、包装状况和真实使用情况的可靠证据。然而，仅有视觉反馈往往缺乏做出明智决策所需的上下文解释和主观意见，同时许多用户由于撰写详细评论需要付出较多精力，只能提供有限的文本反馈。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了基于图像的评论辅助这一新任务，旨在根据用户上传的产品图片生成可编辑的评论草稿。与专注于客观视觉描述的传统图像描述任务不同，该任务要求在具有挑战性的真实世界条件下（包括图像质量下降、过度放大、目标歧义等）进行产品特定理解、情感估计以及基于证据的评论撰写。
tldr: 提出了一项“基于图像的评论辅助”新任务，通过多智能体视觉-语言框架从用户上传的产品图片生成可编辑的评论草稿，弥合视觉反馈与文本评论之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces image-grounded review assistance, a novel task using a multi-agent vision-language framework to generate editable review drafts from user-uploaded product images, bridging the gap between visual feedback and textual reviews.
